messages:
Jamie: Quick PSA — espresso hopper is empty, please don’t try to force a shot. Use the emergency bag in the back drawer (labelled EMERGENCY) until I restock around 3pm. :coffee:

Sasha: Which drawer is 'back drawer'? there are 3 labeled. :sweat_smile:

Jamie: It's the thin one under the microwave, to the left of the spice rack. There's a yellow sticker that says EMERGENCY (handwritten).

Omar: Got it. I grabbed the last bag earlier, my bad. I can swing by the roaster on my way back at 2:50pm if someone wants whole bean.

Katie: I can pick up pods if needed — but whole bean > pods :heart_eyes:

Micah: FYI the grinder is on the windowsill. If you refill beans, please empty the chute (super old grounds in there). Here's the 2-step we follow:

```
1. Open hopper, pour in beans.
2. Run 3 quick grinder pulses to push out stale grounds.
3. Wipe with dry towel, replace hopper.
```

Jamie: Adding — if you use the emergency bag, please write your initials on the sticky so we know what's left. Also, Snackbot will ping when inventory hits 0.

Snackbot: [automated] Office coffee stock level: 1 emergency bag remaining, 2 boxes of tea. Next scheduled restock window: today 15:00.

Sasha: I'll bring a replacement bag at 14:55 if Omar can't. Thanks for the heads-up! :pray:

Micah: Also, who keeps taking the oat milk labelled 'team fridge'? Can we put a sticky that says 'For communal use — please replace'?

Katie: Yes please. I'll print a small sign and stick it on the shelf.

Omar: Coffee rescue team: Omar + Sasha + Jamie. Proceeding to coordinate via DM. :sunglasses:
